root_cause: Pikaday's global keydown listener prevents default for arrow keys whenever the calendar is visible, regardless of which element has focus, trapping arrow keys and preventing caret movement in other inputs.
repair_strategy: Modify _onKeyChange to only handle arrow (and enter/escape) keys when the calendar is visible and the associated input field (or trigger) has focus, preserving date picker navigation when appropriate while allowing normal text field editing.
expected_accessibility_effect: Arrow keys will now function as expected in other text fields when the date picker is visible, allowing users to correct text without moving focus inadvertently; keyboard navigation of the date picker remains functional when the field has focus.
functional_risks: If the picker is bound to a trigger element separate from the field, arrow keys may not work when the trigger has focus.
If opts.field is null, no keyboard navigation will occur (unlikely in typical usage).
Enter and Escape to blur the field will only occur when the field has focus, which is acceptable.
verification_requirements: Test that ArrowLeft in the notes field moves the caret and allows inserting a space to produce "Gate 4".
Verify that arrow keys still change the date when the delivery-date field has focus and the calendar is open.
Ensure Enter and Esc still close the picker and blur the field when appropriate.
Confirm no regression in other keyboard navigation (e.g., PageUp/Down) within the date picker.
Validate behavior with both bound:true and bound:false configurations.
